ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. For latency over a frozen workload distribution, the maximum assurance any H1-H8 system can provide is: (a) an EXACT, offline-verifiable deterministic cost certificate — for every workload item x, a cost value C(f,x) in abstract units (operations executed, bytes hashed, bytes consed, stage invocations) that any third party recomputes to bit-equality, so every quantile of the cost distribution over the frozen workload is a theorem, not a sample; plus (b) a fail-closed cost-budget gate blocking any run whose certified cost exceeds a committed budget; plus (c) a wall-clock claim whose CEILING is K-OF-N EXTERNAL-TIME-AUTHORITY BRACKETING (v1 corrected — producer attestation is NOT the maximum): an offline-verifiable wall-clock BRACKET on a run, obtained by binding committed run events to timestamps from k of n independent external time authorities — Roughtime-class malfeasance-provable timestamps, qualified (eIDAS-class) timestamp authorities, timestamped witness cosignatures — verified against pinned third-party keys with ZERO PRODUCER TRUST, the residue being trust in the external time quorum; the weaker form 'certified cost x attested machine rate r' (producer-signed rate) remains admissible as a typed lower rung. No system can make wall-clock seconds offline-verifiable with zero trust in ANY party; with zero PRODUCER trust, external-authority bracketing is the supremum.
derivation: (1) No-go, restated precisely: wall-clock duration is not a pure function of committed inputs — a replaying verifier obtains a different number — so wall-clock is never verifiable by recomputation alone. The v1 conclusion that producer attestation is therefore the ceiling was too weak: interval BRACKETING by independent external time authorities yields offline-verifiable upper (and lower) bounds on a run's wall-clock extent against pinned third-party keys — zero producer trust, with trust relocated to an external quorum whose malfeasance is provable (Roughtime-class) or legally accountable (qualified timestamps). Hence the wall-clock ceiling is k-of-n external-time-authority bracketing; producer-signed machine rate is a strictly weaker rung. (2) Exactness of the fully-zero-third-party-trust part: because H5 makes the derivation deterministic, the multiset {C(f,x)} over the frozen workload is a computable function of the committed workload — mean, p50, p99, max are exactly computable and re-derivable; sampling error is eliminated entirely. (3) H3 permits the strongest enforcement compatible with the no-go: a fail-closed blocking budget gate on certified cost. The abstract-cost certificate remains the only component requiring zero trust in ANY third party; the bracketing clause is resource-parameterized by the declared time-authority set.
relativity_note: The wall-clock bracketing clause is parameterized by the declared external time-authority set (k, n, key pins); the cost-certificate clause is invariant.
lean_obligation: Theorem (cost determinism and exact quantiles): given f pure, there is a unique c : Input -> Nat with cost e = c x for every execution e of f on x; for a frozen workload w, quantile q (w.map c) is a computable function of w alone, equal across independent replays. No-go lemma: no function of committed inputs equals wall-clock unless wall-clock is constant across conforming executions. Bracketing theorem: given k-of-n timestamp evidence sets over committed run events with pinned authority keys, under an honest-majority assumption on the authority quorum, the verified bracket [lo, hi] contains the true run interval — the quorum assumption appears as an explicit hypothesis, making the relocated trust syntactically visible. Budget gate soundness: c x > budget implies the run is blocked (fail-closed, H3).

attainment_witness_appendix.candidate_mechanism: (1) Deterministic cost meter at the existing single seats — stage invocations and article units at the pipeline stage seat, bytes hashed at hash-authority/merkle-authority, allocation via sb-ext:get-bytes-consed; (2) a persisted hash-chained cost ledger in the [RATCHET-3] pattern, entries (workload-digest, cost-vector, wall-time, machine-fingerprint, signature), wall-time honestly typed as attested-only; (3) fail-closed budget gate as a CLOS :around barrier; (4) exact quantiles emitted through the gate-plenary manifest; (5) NEW under v2 — the bracketing rung: RFC-3161/qualified-timestamp requests (the strict-DER seat already parses TSA structures) and/or Roughtime-class queries binding run start/end event hashes to k-of-n external timestamps, verified against pinned keys.
attainment_witness_appendix.b0_gap_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: AX-17 is effectively absent in the B0 witness — in-memory wall-clock timing that gates nothing, no deterministic cost measure, no persisted ledger, no budget gate, no external time-authority bracketing; every ingredient has a seat pattern to reuse, but the meter, ledger, gate, and bracketing arm are new code.
